title: QQ: A Language Metadata Toolkit for Multilingual NLP
abstract: arXiv:2603.00620v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multilingual NLP research increasingly involves hundreds or thousands of languages across different datasets. Managing, discovering, and reporting language metadata becomes a common hurdle at these scales. We present QQ, a metadata toolkit and browser explorer. QQ compiles language metadata sources into a graph of language varieties, scripts, regions, identifiers, names, and relations, and exposes it through a Python API, a command-line interface, and a browser-based explorer. Users can normalize identifiers, retrieve metadata, traverse relations, and discover which external resources contain a language. We demonstrate QQ on three workflows: an audit of the HuggingFace Hub, linking resources that use different identifier systems, and generating reproducible language-reporting tables. QQ supports FAIR-oriented metadata practices through versioning, open formats, and reusable interfaces.

translated_title: QQ：一个面向多语言NLP的语言元数据工具包
translated_abstract: 多语言NLP研究日益涉及跨不同数据集的数百甚至数千种语言。在这种规模下，管理、发现和报告语言元数据成为一个普遍的障碍。我们提出了QQ，一个元数据工具包和浏览器探索器。QQ将多个语言元数据源编译成一个包含语言变体、文字系统、地区、标识符、名称及其关系的图，并通过Python API、命令行界面和基于浏览器的探索器对外提供访问。用户可以规范化标识符、检索元数据、遍历关系，并发现哪些外部资源包含某种语言。我们在三个工作流程中演示了QQ：对HuggingFace Hub的审计、链接使用不同标识符系统的资源，以及生成可复现的语言报告表格。QQ通过版本控制、开放格式和可复用接口支持面向FAIR原则的元数据实践。
tldr: QQ是一个面向多语言NLP的语言元数据工具包，它将分散的元数据源整合为可查询的语言图谱，并通过Python API、命令行和浏览器界面支持标识符规范化、资源发现和可复现的语言报告。
en_tdlr: QQ is a language metadata toolkit for multilingual NLP that compiles scattered metadata sources into a queryable graph of language varieties, scripts, and identifiers, exposed through a Python API, CLI, and browser explorer to support identifier normalization, resource discovery, and reproducible language reporting.
